## Send it

Copy this into `bot.ts` and run it. From WhatsApp Android, send `!receipt` to the bot.

```ts bot.ts
import { Client, html, htmlJson } from 'zaileys'

const client = new Client({ commandPrefix: '!' })

const data = {
  "store": "Example Coffee House",
  "receiptNo": "INV-2026-0142",
  "date": "15 Sep 2026, 09:41",
  "currency": "IDR",
  "locale": "id-ID",
  "items": [
    {
      "name": "Iced Palm Sugar Latte",
      "qty": 2,
      "price": 28000
    },
    {
      "name": "Butter Croissant",
      "qty": 1,
      "price": 22000
    },
    {
      "name": "Americano",
      "qty": 1,
      "price": 20000
    },
    {
      "name": "Banana Bread",
      "qty": 2,
      "price": 18000
    },
    {
      "name": "Mineral Water",
      "qty": 1,
      "price": 8000
    },
    {
      "name": "Chocolate Cookie",
      "qty": 3,
      "price": 9000
    }
  ],
  "discount": {
    "label": "Member discount",
    "amount": 15000
  },
  "tax": {
    "label": "Tax 10%",
    "amount": 15400
  },
  "total": 169400,
  "paymentMethod": "QRIS",
  "thankYou": "Thank you for visiting. See you again!"
}

const card = html`
<!doctype html>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<style>
  :root { --pink: #ff4f8b; --orange: #ff8a3d; --yellow: #ffc93c; --lime: #9be15d; --mint: #2ed8a7; --sky: #38b6ff; --violet: #7c5cff; --ink: #1d1442; --cream: #fff8ec; --muted: #5b5380; --line: #dcd0ef; --minus: #0a7a5a; }
  * { box-sizing: border-box; -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent; }
  [hidden] { display: none !important; }
  body { margin: 0; height: 100%; background: linear-gradient(150deg, var(--mint), var(--sky)); color: var(--ink); font: 14px/1.3 system-ui, sans-serif; display: flex; padding: 12px 12px 20px; }
  .paper { position: relative; flex: 1; min-width: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; background: var(--cream); border-radius: 22px 22px 0 0; padding: 16px 16px 12px; box-shadow: 0 6px 0 rgba(29, 20, 66, .12); }
  /* Torn-paper bottom edge: cream triangles hanging below the paper. */
  .paper::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 100%; height: 9px; background: conic-gradient(from -45deg at 50% 100%, var(--cream) 90deg, transparent 0) 0 0 / 18px 9px repeat-x; }
  header { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; min-height: 44px; }
  .paid header { padding-right: 58px; }
  .logo { flex: none; width: 38px; height: 38px; border-radius: 14px; display: grid; place-items: center; font-size: 22px; background: linear-gradient(135deg, var(--yellow), var(--orange)); box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #d9661d; }
  .head { min-width: 0; }
  .store { font-size: 18px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1.2; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .meta { margin-top: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0 8px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .meta span { white-space: nowrap; }
  .stamp { position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 10px; width: 58px; height: 58px; border-radius: 50%; display: grid; place-items: center; text-align: center; background: var(--pink); box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #c42762; transform: rotate(-14deg); animation: stamp .5s cubic-bezier(.3, 1.6, .5, 1) both .15s; }
  .stamp b { width: 48px; height: 48px; border-radius: 50%; border: 2px dashed var(--ink); display: grid; place-items: center; align-content: center; background: var(--yellow); font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: .04em; line-height: 1; }
  .stamp small { display: block; font-size: 14px; margin-top: 1px; }
  @keyframes stamp { from { opacity: 0; transform: rotate(-40deg) scale(1.8); } to { opacity: 1; transform: rotate(-14deg) scale(1); } }
  .rule { flex: none; margin: 9px 0; border-top: 2px dashed var(--line); }
  #items { flex: 1; min-height: 0; overflow: hidden; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; }
  #items li { flex: none; }
  #items li .name::before { content: ''; display: inline-block; width: 8px; height: 8px; margin: 0 7px 1px 0; border-radius: 3px; background: var(--pink); vertical-align: middle; }
  #items li:nth-child(5n+2) .name::before { background: var(--orange); }
  #items li:nth-child(5n+3) .name::before { background: var(--mint); }
  #items li:nth-child(5n+4) .name::before { background: var(--sky); }
  #items li:nth-child(5n+5) .name::before { background: var(--violet); }
  .row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline; gap: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .row .name { min-width: 0; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  #items .row .name { font-weight: 600; }
  .row .amt { flex: none; font-weight: 600; }
  .each { padding-left: 15px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }
  .more, .empty { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; }
  #sums { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; color: var(--muted); font-size: 13px; }
  #sums .minus { color: var(--minus); }
  .total { margin-top: 8px; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; gap: 12px; padding: 6px 14px; border-radius: 16px; background: linear-gradient(100deg, var(--mint), var(--sky)); }
  .total span { font-weight: 800; }
  .total b { min-width: 0; font-size: clamp(22px, 7vw, 28px); font-weight: 800; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  footer { margin-top: 8px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 5px; text-align: center; min-width: 0; }
  .pay { max-width: 100%; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 12px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; background: var(--ink); color: #fff; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  .pay b { color: var(--yellow); font-weight: 800; }
  .thanks { color: var(--muted); font-size: 12px; max-width: 100%; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; }
  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .stamp { animation: none; } }
</style>
<main class="paper" aria-label="Receipt">
  <header>
    <span class="logo" aria-hidden="true">🧾</span>
    <div class="head">
      <div class="store" id="store"></div>
      <div class="meta"><span id="number"></span><span id="date"></span></div>
    </div>
  </header>
  <div class="stamp" id="stamp" hidden><b>PAID<small aria-hidden="true">✓</small></b></div>
  <div class="rule"></div>
  <ul id="items" aria-label="Items"></ul>
  <div class="rule"></div>
  <div id="sums"></div>
  <div class="total"><span>Total</span><b id="total"></b></div>
  <footer>
    <div class="pay" id="pay"></div>
    <div class="thanks" id="thanks"></div>
  </footer>
</main>
<script>
  var DATA = ${htmlJson(data)};
  var TEXT = {
    store: 'Receipt',
    subtotal: 'Subtotal',
    tax: 'Tax',
    discount: 'Discount',
    paidWith: 'Paid with ',
    noItems: 'No items listed',
    more: function (n) { return '+' + n + ' more item' + (n === 1 ? '' : 's'); }
  };
  var d = DATA || {};
  var items = Array.isArray(d.items) ? d.items : [];

  function num(v) { return typeof v === 'number' && isFinite(v) ? v : null; }

  function formatters(currency, locale) {
    var loc = locale || undefined, money, plain;
    try { new Intl.NumberFormat(loc); } catch (e) { loc = undefined; }
    try {
      money = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { style: 'currency', currency: currency, currencyDisplay: 'code' });
      var digits = money.resolvedOptions().maximumFractionDigits;
      plain = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { minimumFractionDigits: digits, maximumFractionDigits: digits });
    } catch (e) {
      plain = new Intl.NumberFormat(loc, { maximumFractionDigits: 2 });
      money = { format: function (v) { return (currency ? currency + ' ' : '') + plain.format(v); } };
    }
    return { money: function (v) { return money.format(v); }, plain: function (v) { return plain.format(v); } };
  }
  var fmt = formatters(d.currency, d.locale);

  function lineAmount(item) {
    var qty = num(item.qty) === null ? 1 : item.qty;
    if (num(item.amount) !== null) return item.amount;
    return num(item.price) === null ? null : qty * item.price;
  }

  function itemRow(item) {
    var li = document.createElement('li');
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'row';
    var name = document.createElement('span');
    name.className = 'name';
    name.textContent = item.name || 'Item';
    var amt = document.createElement('span');
    amt.className = 'amt';
    var total = lineAmount(item);
    amt.textContent = total === null ? '' : fmt.plain(total);
    row.appendChild(name);
    row.appendChild(amt);
    li.appendChild(row);
    // A single unit repeats the line amount, so the unit price only shows for qty above one.
    if (num(item.price) !== null && (num(item.qty) === null ? 1 : item.qty) !== 1) {
      var each = document.createElement('div');
      each.className = 'each';
      each.textContent = (num(item.qty) === null ? 1 : item.qty) + ' × ' + fmt.plain(item.price);
      li.appendChild(each);
    }
    return li;
  }

  var list = document.getElementById('items');

  // Rows are dropped from the end until the list fits, since the card cannot scroll.
  function renderItems() {
    for (var shown = items.length; shown >= 0; shown--) {
      list.textContent = '';
      if (!items.length) {
        var none = document.createElement('li');
        none.className = 'empty';
        none.textContent = TEXT.noItems;
        list.appendChild(none);
        return;
      }
      for (var i = 0; i < shown; i++) list.appendChild(itemRow(items[i]));
      if (shown < items.length) {
        var more = document.createElement('li');
        more.className = 'more';
        more.textContent = TEXT.more(items.length - shown);
        list.appendChild(more);
      }
      if (list.scrollHeight <= list.clientHeight + 1) return;
    }
  }

  function sumRow(label, value, minus) {
    var row = document.createElement('div');
    row.className = 'row' + (minus ? ' minus' : '');
    var l = document.createElement('span');
    l.className = 'name';
    l.textContent = label;
    var v = document.createElement('span');
    v.className = 'amt';
    v.textContent = (minus ? '− ' : '') + fmt.plain(Math.abs(value));
    row.appendChild(l);
    row.appendChild(v);
    document.getElementById('sums').appendChild(row);
  }

  function adjustment(entry, fallbackLabel) {
    if (!entry) return null;
    if (num(entry) !== null) return { label: fallbackLabel, amount: entry };
    return num(entry.amount) === null ? null : { label: entry.label || fallbackLabel, amount: entry.amount };
  }

  document.getElementById('store').textContent = d.store || TEXT.store;
  document.getElementById('number').textContent = d.receiptNo ? '#' + d.receiptNo : '';
  document.getElementById('date').textContent = d.date || '';

  var computed = 0, known = items.length > 0;
  items.forEach(function (item) {
    var a = lineAmount(item);
    if (a === null) known = false; else computed += a;
  });
  var subtotal = num(d.subtotal) !== null ? d.subtotal : known ? computed : null;
  var tax = adjustment(d.tax, TEXT.tax);
  var discount = adjustment(d.discount, TEXT.discount);
  if (subtotal !== null && (tax || discount)) sumRow(TEXT.subtotal, subtotal);
  if (tax) sumRow(tax.label, tax.amount);
  if (discount) sumRow(discount.label, discount.amount, true);

  var total = num(d.total);
  if (total === null && subtotal !== null) total = subtotal + (tax ? tax.amount : 0) - (discount ? Math.abs(discount.amount) : 0);
  var totalEl = document.getElementById('total');
  totalEl.textContent = total === null ? 'Not available' : fmt.money(total);
  if (total === null) totalEl.style.fontSize = '17px';

  var pay = document.getElementById('pay');
  if (d.paymentMethod) {
    pay.textContent = TEXT.paidWith;
    var method = document.createElement('b');
    method.textContent = d.paymentMethod;
    pay.appendChild(method);
    document.getElementById('stamp').hidden = false;
    document.querySelector('.paper').classList.add('paid');
  } else {
    pay.hidden = true;
  }
  document.getElementById('thanks').textContent = d.thankYou || '';
  // Long amounts shrink to fit rather than being cut off, since a clipped number would misstate it.
  function fitText(el, min) {
    el.style.fontSize = '';
    var size = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(el).fontSize);
    while (el.scrollWidth > el.clientWidth && size > min) { size -= 1; el.style.fontSize = size + 'px'; }
  }
  function layout() {
    renderItems();
    if (total !== null) fitText(totalEl, 14);
  }
  layout();
  addEventListener('resize', layout);
</script>
`

client.command('receipt', async (ctx) => {
  await ctx.send().htmlApp(card, {
    title: "Receipt",
    height: 460,
    device: ctx.senderDevice,
    fallback: "Your receipt card opens on WhatsApp Android only.",
  })
})
```

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Height | 460 px |
| Size | 11.9 KB |
| Input | None, display only |
| Download prompt | Skipped by the default `bypassDownload`. A reload when the keyboard opens is invisible on this card |
| Tested | Not yet tested on a phone |

The card works only on WhatsApp Android, with no network or storage. Other devices get the `fallback` text. See [HTML apps](/messaging/html-app) for every option and limit.
